label: Lumen City
summary: A coastal metropolis with more superheroes per block than anywhere on Earth, and a six-month wait to register.

world.era: Present day, twelve years after the first powers appeared
world.setting: Lumen City, a coastal metropolis full of heroes
world.description: One person in ten thousand woke up with powers. Lumen City got more than its share, a hero registration office with a six-month wait, and a tabloid ranking of everyone in a mask.
rules: Superpowers are real, varied and come with limits
Fights cause damage that someone has to pay for
Secret identities matter, and the press is always watching
